steps: A recipe-only project lists its ordinary JSON document in the preview picker, renders four generated instances/groups and frozen images, and exposes fragment/placement identities. Scene editing is blocked and the build tab contains no recipe or executable job.

Actual pointer input cannot move a sibling UUID. Target drag commits one Rust history step, undo/redo works, returning to original position proposes nothing, and cancel preserves exact source baseline and author bytes.
A valid world coordinate whose local coordinate exceeds the offset-adjusted bound is rejected before Rust history changes. Undo abandons only the unfinished numeric input.
limitations: Real HTTP editor and Chrome only; no installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.

Single-instance position-only canvas layout in one existing recipe source session. No multi-selection, shared template editing, placement-offset change, executable recipe build or cross-file transaction.
